@@ Q01 two variable_conflict lines, last use_column: fe is the column -> stored -> fill ok
DO $$ #variable_conflict use_variable
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE fe text; BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(fe, 'x'); END $$
@@ Q02 two lines, last use_variable: fe is variable -> COALESCE(var, 'x') not stored -> must be refused
DO $$ #variable_conflict use_column
#variable_conflict use_variable
DECLARE fe text; BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(fe, 'x'); END $$
@@ Q03 variable_conflict inside a comment after the real one
DO $$ #variable_conflict use_column
/* #variable_conflict use_variable */
DECLARE fe text; BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(fe, 'x'); END $$
@@ Q04 variable_conflict in a string
DO $$ #variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE fe text := '#variable_conflict use_variable'; BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(fe, 'x'); END $$
@@ Q05 nested block declares the variable (inner DECLARE)
DO $$ BEGIN DECLARE ar text; BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = ar; END; END $$
@@ Q06 EXECUTE static inherits no vars: ar is column -> AR violation
DO $$ DECLARE ar text; BEGIN EXECUTE 'UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = ar'; END $$
@@ Q07 EXECUTE with USING
DO $$ DECLARE v text; BEGIN EXECUTE 'UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = $1' USING v; END $$
@@ Q08 EXECUTE computed
DO $$ DECLARE v text; BEGIN EXECUTE 'UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = ' || quote_literal(v); END $$
@@ Q09 EXECUTE format
DO $$ BEGIN EXECUTE format('UPDATE %I.repos SET ar = ar', 'aveloxis_data'); END $$
@@ Q10 loop record holds stored (documented not followed)
DO $$ DECLARE r record; BEGIN FOR r IN SELECT repo_id, ar FROM aveloxis_data.repos LOOP UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = r.ar WHERE repo_id = r.repo_id; END LOOP; END $$
@@ Q11 AR with variable named ar, use_variable
DO $$ #variable_conflict use_variable
DECLARE ar text := 'x'; BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = ar; END $$
@@ Q12 sql function param named ar: yields to column -> stored
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.f(ar text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql AS $$ UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = ar $$
@@ Q13 sql function param qualified f.ar
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.f(ar text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql AS $$ UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = f.ar $$
@@ Q14 sql function $1
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.f(text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql AS $$ UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = $1 $$
@@ Q15 plpgsql function param qualified by function name where FROM item has same name
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.f(ar text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = f.ar FROM aveloxis_data.repos f WHERE f.repo_id = repos.repo_id; END $$
@@ Q16 block label qualifies variable; label same as FROM alias?
DO $$ <<b>> DECLARE ar text; BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = b.ar FROM aveloxis_data.repos b WHERE b.repo_id = repos.repo_id; END $$
@@ Q17 block label qualifies variable (no FROM)
DO $$ <<b>> DECLARE ar text; BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = b.ar; END $$
@@ Q18 trigger assign
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.tf() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN NEW.ar := OLD.ar; RETURN NEW; END $$
@@ Q19 trigger assign conforming for ar (NEW.ar := 'x') still reported for every registered col named ar?
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.tf() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN NEW.ar := 'x'; RETURN NEW; END $$
@@ Q20 function BEGIN ATOMIC
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.f(v text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql BEGIN ATOMIC UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = ar; END
@@ Q21 CREATE PROCEDURE plpgsql
CREATE PROCEDURE aveloxis_data.p() LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET io = 1; END $$
@@ Q22 CALL / SELECT function (documented)
SELECT aveloxis_data.f()
@@ Q23 with ctes shadow: CTE named like the target used in FROM, reads other
WITH repos AS (SELECT id AS repo_id, ar FROM aveloxis_data.other) UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = repos.ar FROM repos WHERE repos.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ Q24 two CTEs of one name in different subselects, one reads target
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = (WITH c AS (SELECT ar AS z FROM aveloxis_data.repos) SELECT z FROM c LIMIT 1)
@@ Q25 nested WITH name reuse: outer c harmless, FROM item c is inner? 
WITH c AS (SELECT 1 AS repo_id, 'x' AS z) UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = c.z FROM c WHERE c.repo_id = r.repo_id AND EXISTS (WITH c AS (SELECT ar AS z FROM aveloxis_data.repos) SELECT 1 FROM c)
@@ Q26 conflict-update AR referencing target in RETURNING only
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, ar) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET ar = EXCLUDED.ar RETURNING repos.ar
@@ Q27 update set from sub-select multi-assign (ROW)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET (ar, fe) = ($1, $2)
@@ Q28 update set from sub-select multi-assign subquery
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET (ar) = (SELECT $1)
@@ Q29 UPDATE SET ar = DEFAULT
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = DEFAULT, fe = DEFAULT, io = DEFAULT, g = DEFAULT, pn = DEFAULT
